_comment: The committed baseline for main's branch protection. `required` must equal the live required_status_checks.checks (context AND app_id) and `strict` the live strict flag; branch-protection-drift.yml compares them daily. `advisory_pending` are checks that run on every PR but are not yet required; `cargo-vet` among them stays advisory on purpose (the promotion runbook in docs/MAINTAINING.md excludes it). Every name here is validated at PR time by .github/scripts/required_checks_guard.py (lint job): renaming one of these jobs fails `lint` instead of silently orphaning a required context. 15368 is GitHub Actions' app id. `enforce_admins` and `tag_ruleset` are compared by .github/scripts/protection-drift.sh; while `pending_settings` is true a mismatch in those two only warns (they are applied by hand by the maintainer), and context/strict drift always fails. `tag_ruleset` is the rulesets API body with rules as bare type names; `bypass_actors` is compared only if the API returns it to the read-only drift token.
